text:
Priya Singh: Customer reported large latency and 403 spikes after we rolled the EU dedicated pool yesterday. They say calls pinned to dedicated-eu-42 are being routed to hosted-us-east and failing auth. cc @eng

Jae Park: Can you paste a sample request id + headers?

Priya Singh: Request-ID: req_0a1b2c3d, trace: 4a2f. Headers we see from customer: 
`X-Customer-Pin: dedicated-eu-42` 
`X-Client-Region: eu-west-1`
`Authorization: Bearer sk-live-...`

Priya Singh: From our ingress logs: 
`2026-03-15T14:22:11Z req_0a1b2c3d route_pinned=false fallback=hosted-us-east latency_ms=720 auth_status=403`

Tom Reynolds: 720ms -> definitely crossing continents. Looks like the pin lookup returned miss and fallback service chose hosted. Did the pin table sync finish?

Alice Mendez: I see TTL refresh churn around that time. Pin-service emitted a couple of errors to KV: `etcd: leader changed` and some 5xx. Could be an intermittent write loss.

routing-bot: Routing monitor detected "pin-miss-rate" spike for customer acme-inc (0.8 -> 6.4/min) at 2026-03-15T14:20Z. Fallback fraction increased to 37%.

Jae Park: Ok repro plan: 1) curl with pin header from eu node 2) observe `x-routing-destination` in response 3) check pin-store for key `pins:acme-inc:session`

Priya Singh: Repro from our EU testbox (eu-sim-01): 
```
curl -i -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-test" -H "X-Customer-Pin: dedicated-eu-42" \ 
  -H "X-Client-Region: eu-west-1" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
```
Response headers: 
`x-routing-destination: hosted-us-east-1`
`x-request-id: req_dbg_77`
Status: 200 but latency 650ms and tokens billed to hosted pool (billing-id hdr present).

Tom Reynolds: That confirms it. Pin-service returned a stale or missing entry. Can you paste the KV lookup?

Alice Mendez: KV lookup log: `GET /kv/pins/acme-inc/dedicated-eu-42 -> 404 (etcd stale read)` then we fallback to route selector and picked hosted-us-east since it had capacity.

Jae Park: Two parts: immediate mitigation and root cause. Mitigation: force-route for this customer to dedicated-eu-42 for next 1 hour while we repair TTL. I can push a quick override: `routing.set_override(customer="acme-inc", dest="dedicated-eu-42", ttl=3600)`

Priya Singh: Please do that, customer on the line and latency complaints coming in. :rotating_light:

routing-bot: Override applied by Jae Park at 2026-03-15T14:31Z. Old fallback policy still in place.

Tom Reynolds: For root cause, Alice, can you check etcd logs around 14:19-14:25 and whether the pin-service had retries/backoff? Also check our pin-store migration that ran last night.

Alice Mendez: Noted. Early finding: there was a migration sweep that wrote keys with a short TTL unintentionally (ttl=30s). That explains pin expiry and high miss rate. I'm rolling a repair to refresh pins with correct TTL=7d now.

Jae Park: Good catch. Follow-ups: 1) Add a validation in the migration to prevent TTL<1h for pin keys. 2) Add alert for sudden pin-miss spike per-customer. 3) Add audit to compare billed destination vs pinned destination hourly.

Priya Singh: Customer confirmed latency dropped after override. They also reported a billing spike — hosted tokens charged for last 2 hours. Who owns billing adjustment for hosted tokens routed mistakenly?

Tom Reynolds: Tagging finance & support runbook. We'll create a credit request referencing the request IDs. Action: Priya to assemble request-ids, Jae to add evidence (KV misses + routing decisions).

Priya Singh: Assembling req list now. Also will include repro steps and the temporary override ID.

Alice Mendez: Repair complete, repopulated 100% of pins for acme-inc with ttl=604800. Monitoring for drop to 0% fallback.

routing-bot: Post-fix metrics: fallback fraction for acme-inc reduced to 0.9% within 10m.

Jae Park: Leaving the override for 30m then will fade to let normal routing resume. I'll follow up with a short postmortem and link to runbook changes. :thumbsup:

Priya Singh: Thanks everyone — will keep the customer updated and file the billing credit ticket.

Tom Reynolds: We should also check other customers touched by last-night migration, doing a TTL audit across pin keys next 2h.

Alice Mendez: Running audit now — will post results in this thread.
